_comment: Copy to config.json (git-ignored) and replace every value with your own IDs. Use `./tk.sh discover` for the TimeKeeper IDs. Straight quotes, numeric IDs only. The numbers below are made-up placeholders.

approval._rerun_hint_note: Optional. Ends the 'week not approved' error: 'Approve the week in Kleer, then <rerun_hint>.' Put your own way of re-running here, e.g. "ask your agent to run the time-assistant skill again".

scope._note: Only this ONE source project is replicated, into this ONE TimeKeeper project. Everything else is ignored.
scope._tk_name: Consulting engagement (use the INTERNAL id from `discover`, not the project number)

default._note: There is no list endpoint for wage codes: copy wagecodeID from an existing expense row in TimeKeeper.
